{{Quote|The fineband scope makes it look like there's an entire ''fleet'' ahead. No ''wonder'' those Imperials swung off our tail!''"<br />"''Er&hellip; ''Han?'' I ''know'' the beacon's on Rebel frequency, but&hellip; the Alliance doesn't ''have'' a fleet in this sector!|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="Deadly" />}}
The '''Mayagil sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] included [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]], [[H'nemthe/Legends|H'nemthe]], [[Öetrago/Legends|Öetrago]], [[Triton/Legends|Triton]], [[Virmeude]], [[Xagobah/Legends|Xagobah]] and [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]]. [[Mezhra Station]] and the [[Dunari's Rest]] casino were also in the Mayagil sector.

==History==
The Mayagil sector was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Dodra F'ass]]; it seceded and joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and was represented later by [[Nara Deega]] and later by [[E'noro]] in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Mayagil sector was known to be a favorite of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] making their way between more habitable regions. [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] had [[The fringe|underworld]] contacts on various [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of this [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="BF:ANT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] incorrectly places [[Chalcedon/Legends|Chalcedon]], [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], [[Urdur/Legends|Urdur]] and [[Cona/Legends|Cona]] in the Mayagil sector. Chalcedon is in the [[Tashtor sector/Legends|Tashtor sector]]; Urdur is in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]; Dantooine is in the [[Raioballo sector/Legends|Raioballo sector]]; [[Cona/Legends|Cona]] is in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].
